attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "The change to LayerFilter uses `await _adminThemeService?.GetAdminThemeNameAsync()`, which will throw a NullReferenceException (not just skip) when IAdminThemeService is null—i.e., precisely on sites without the Admin feature enabled, the exact scenario this fix was meant to support—breaking a widely-used result filter in the render pipeline."}

reason: The change to LayerFilter uses `await _adminThemeService?.GetAdminThemeNameAsync()`, which will throw a NullReferenceException (not just skip) when IAdminThemeService is null—i.e., precisely on sites without the Admin feature enabled, the exact scenario this fix was meant to support—breaking a widely-used result filter in the render pipeline.
